Incoming sappy tweet, but it’s pretty wild to see where I am now vs 5 months ago. I thought I had the job that’d jump start my career only for me to be let go soon after. It was performance related and it is what it is. I needed to be better & I failed. That was the week of 11/25

Fast forward to 1/20; I’ve moved 1000 miles west to Missouri to move in with my brother. No job lined up, no real plan, no friends. I was anxious & excited because I really didn’t know what was next & for the first time, I said to myself “Fuck it. We’ll figure it out.”

Now we’re at 2/8, I find myself at a new job where I’m excelling every day I’m there, and I’m getting a sense of accomplishment whereas before I was afraid to mess up the smallest of tasks. I’ve moved on, and the important takeaway is that everything will be okay eventually.
